rows.label: Wayne Gretzky
rows.description: Canadian ice hockey player and coach (born 1961)
rows.hook: is nicknamed The Great One and holds the NHL records for career goals and points

rows.label: Alexander Ovechkin
rows.hook: passed a legendary record to become the NHL's all-time leading goal scorer, playing for the Capitals

rows.label: Sidney Crosby
rows.hook: captains the Pittsburgh Penguins and won three Stanley Cups plus Olympic gold medals

rows.label: Connor Hellebuyck
rows.hook: is a star goaltender for the Winnipeg Jets who has won the Vezina Trophy

rows.label: Cale Makar
rows.hook: is a star defenseman for the Colorado Avalanche who won the Norris Trophy and a Stanley Cup

rows.label: Connor McDavid
rows.hook: is a blazing-fast Edmonton Oilers captain and multiple-time league scoring champion

rows.label: Auston Matthews
rows.hook: is a Toronto Maple Leafs star who scored over 60 goals in a single season

rows.label: Mario Lemieux
rows.description: Canadian ice hockey player and team owner
rows.hook: was a Pittsburgh Penguins superstar who beat cancer and later owned the team

rows.label: Gordie Howe
rows.hook: was nicknamed Mr. Hockey and played professionally in five different decades

rows.label: Quinn Hughes
rows.hook: is a Norris Trophy-winning defenseman who captains the Vancouver Canucks

rows.label: Jack Hughes
rows.hook: was the first overall pick in his draft and is a star centre for the New Jersey Devils

rows.label: Bobby Orr
rows.hook: revolutionized the defenseman position and scored the famous Cup-winning goal while flying through the air

rows.label: Joe Thornton
rows.hook: was a long-time San Jose Sharks centre known for his big beard and playmaking

rows.label: Matthew Tkachuk
rows.hook: is a gritty Florida Panthers forward who has won back-to-back Stanley Cups

rows.label: Evgeni Malkin
rows.hook: is a longtime Pittsburgh Penguins centre who won the Conn Smythe Trophy and three Stanley Cups

rows.label: Phil Kessel
rows.hook: won two Stanley Cups with Pittsburgh and famously played a huge streak of consecutive games

rows.label: P. K. Subban
rows.hook: is a flashy defenseman who won a Norris Trophy with the Montreal Canadiens

rows.label: Steve Yzerman
rows.hook: captained the Detroit Red Wings to three Stanley Cups and later became their general manager
